description: Pins one widget or a saved artifact onto the operator's home canvas. kind='widget' requires widget_key from the shipped enum; kind='artifact' requires content_ref (an assistant artifact id) — the door enforces whichever pair the kind demands, since the schema alone cannot express it. Rows are private to the creating user, even though teammates share the same tenant. NEXT: desk_surface_list reads the current layout.
